text:
emily: Heads up  my cousin is swinging by around 3:30 with a small cheesecake and a tote. Can we have a guest badge and a little table by the kitchenette? Also I ordered a plant stand that may arrive today, pls hold if it shows up. :cake::seedling:
front-desk: No problem. Guests get a day badge and must sign in. Table by kitchenette okay but it's shared; we'll put a 'Reserved' sticky. Which name for the badge?
emily: Badge name: 'Evan Ramos'. And the plant stand is for 'Emily Tran' if it arrives.
reception-bot: Guest badge queued for "Evan Ramos" at 15:18. Badge ID G-3010.
kevin: FYI if the cheesecake is nut-based pls put it on the top shelf of the kitchenette fridge and label it. We had a nut incident last month.
nina: Also a quick ask  can packages for events be left on the lower mail shelf? We usually put food/fragile on the pink locker. @mailroom?
mailroom: Noted. We store perishables in fridge or locker P1. Non-perishables go to main shelf. If a mixup happens we'll ring the recipient.
front-desk: Update: small box arrived labeled 'plant stand' for Emily Tran at 15:24. Placed in locker A3 with sticky note "fragile - stand". Also a small padded envelope arrived labeled 'E. Tran'  unsure of contents, placed in A3 too.
emily: Thanks! Could someone also flag if any packages look like paper towels? I ordered those too and they can be left by mail shelf.
kevin: Random question: does anyone want cheesecake? :eyes:
emily: save a slice for me pls :pleading_face:
front-desk: Guest checked in at 15:31. Badge handed to Evan. We rang x1102 and confirmed cheesecake can be stored in fridge. Table reserved by kitchenette.
mailroom: Slight hiccup: someone grabbed a padded envelope from the A3 shelf earlier by mistake (thought it was their charger). We tracked them down and swapped back the items. All packages accounted for now. Sorry for the scare.
emily: Oh no! Thanks for sorting. Who grabbed it? It's fine as long as it's back.
mailroom: Kevin stopped by and had picked up a similar-looking envelope, realized and returned it when we called. No damage.
kevin: guilty as charged  my bad, thought it was my dongle. All good now, sorry! :sweat_smile:
nina: Note for future: if envelopes have handwritten labels, please put a colored sticker on event stuff. Saves confusion.
front-desk: Will start using blue event stickers for food/party items. Also adding 'Perishable' tag to locker notes.
emily: Amazing, you all are lifesavers. Cheesecake and plant stand all safe. See you in a bit! :tada:
